inputSchema.description: Structural validity. Option values must also be unique and include the selected value; commands must belong to the approved runtime. Unknown properties are ignored. Full replacement, not a partial update.
Structural v1 request. UTF-8 encoded byte, nested field and runtime limits are enforced separately. Unknown top-level fields are ignored. Structured options require host 0.33.0-beta.5 or later.

resultSchema.description: Accepted for diagnostic logging, subject to level filters and a bounded lossy writer. Not an acknowledgement of durable storage. No event subscription is created.

inputSchema.description: Nonempty plain text without NUL. Runtime limits count UTF-16 code units; the shared 256KiB UTF-8 request budget also applies. Additional fields are ignored.

resultSchema.description: True only on confirmation; false on dismissal, replacement or 55-second UI expiry. Runtime expiry/revocation can instead reject.

inputSchema.description: Additional fields are ignored; omitted payload becomes null. The independent shared request quota is 256KiB of serialized UTF-8 JSON.

resultSchema.description: Transport acceptance only, not subscriber processing or durable delivery.

eventSchema.description: Host-supplied identity and runtime generation. Advisory payload, no permission grant or replay. A recipient must reject a retired generation; concurrent calls need not complete in order.
